topic_title: Law and Purpose of Vehicle Lighting Equipment
prompt: Under Texas Transportation Code §547.302, when must a driver display lighted vehicle lamps?

options.text: Exclusively between sunset and sunrise when street lights are unlit
From one hour after sunset until one hour before sunrise in rural areas
Only when rain or fog reduces forward sight distance below one hundred feet
From 30 minutes after sunset to 30 minutes before sunrise, or if visibility < 1000 ft
